## Load Packages

```{r}
setwd("~/R Studio/NSAS Herring/NSAS-Herring")

library(bcp)
library(changepoint)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(FSA)
library(strucchange)
library(MASS)
library(hydroGOF)
library(mgcv)
library(INDperform)
```

## Import data

```{r}
load("data/Herring_LAI.Rdata")
load("data/env_df_subset.Rdata")

### Split data into components
Herring_ShOr <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney",]
Herring_Buchan <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Buchan",]
Herring_Banks <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Banks",]
Herring_Downs <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Downs",]
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
# Shetland / Orkney
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = Herring_ShOr$SSB_component, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
Herring_Shetland_Orkney$year[c(12, 19, 23, 25, 34, 43)]
#### Index: 12,   19,   23,   25,   34,   43
#### Years: 1983, 1990, 1994, 1996, 2005, 2014

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(Herring_ShOr$SSB_component)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
Herring_Shetland_Orkney$year[c(12, 19, 23, 31, 34, 43)]
#### Index: 12,   19,   23,   31,   34,   43
#### Years: 1983, 1990, 1994, 2002, 2005, 2014

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1983, 1990, 2005, 2014

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Buchan
### cpts analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = Herring_Buchan$SSB_component, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
Herring_Buchan$year[c(15, 18, 22, 38, 40, 47)]
#### Index: 11,   18,   22,   38,   40,   47
#### Years: 1986, 1989, 1993, 2009, 2011, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(Herring_Buchan$SSB_component)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.7)
Herring_Buchan$year[c(18, 30, 39, 47)]
#### Index: 18-23, 30,  39,   46-47
#### Years: 1989, 2001, 2010, 2018

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1989, 2009, 2018

## Plot change-points

```{r}
### Load functions from "functions"
source("R/functions.R")

### Shetland Orkney
plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_ShOr, 
              changepoints = c(1983, 1990, 2005, 2014),
              component = "Shetland / Orkney", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component",
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR

### Buchan
plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_Buchan, 
              changepoints = c(1989, 2009, 2018),
              component = "Buchan", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan

### Banks
plot_SSB_cpt_Banks <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_Banks, 
              changepoints = c(1982, 1990, 2000, 2018),
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "purple", "lightgreen", "grey"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "black", "black", "grey"),
              component = "Banks", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Banks

### Downs
plot_SSB_cpt_Downs <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_Downs, 
              changepoints = c(1987, 2001, 2011, 2021),
              ribbon_colors = c("grey", "steelblue", "orange", "purple", "grey"),
              vline_colors = c("grey", "black", "black","grey"),
              component = "Downs", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plot_SSB_cpt_Downs
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_components.png"),
       plot = gridExtra::grid.arrange(plot_SSB_cpt_SHOR, 
                                      plot_SSB_cpt_Buchan,

                                      plot_SSB_cpt_Downs, ncol = 2),
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Examine for time lag
ccf(Herring_ShOr$SSB_component, Herring_ShOr$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag

ccf(Herring_Buchan$SSB_component, Herring_Buchan$F, type = "correlation") # 3 years lag

ccf(Herring_Banks$SSB_component, Herring_Banks$F, type = "correlation") # 5 years lag

ccf(Herring_Downs$SSB_component, Herring_Downs$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag

### Call function "breakpoint_analysis"
brkpt_results_list <- list()
brkpt_results_list$ShOr <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_ShOr, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 1, 
                                    region_name = "Shetland Orkney",
                                    dataset_name = "Herring_ShOr")

# Optimal number of breaks: 5 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.28 0.29 0.189 0.29 0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1983, 1990, 1997, 2005, 2015 

brkpt_results_list$Buchan <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_Buchan, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Buchan",
                                    dataset_name = "Herring_Buchan")
# Optimal number of breaks: 3
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.29 0.189 0.184 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1990, 1997, 2012 

brkpt_results_list$Banks <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_Banks, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 5, 
                                    region_name = "Banks",
                                    dataset_name = "Herring_Banks")
# Optimal number of breaks: 2
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.39 0.29 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1988, 2005 

brkpt_results_list$Downs <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_Downs, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 1, 
                                    region_name = "Downs",
                                    dataset_name = "Herring_Downs")
# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.41 0.171 0.073 0.24 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1987, 2002, 2009, 2016 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis 
plot_hysteresis_ShOr <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_ShOr, brkpt_results_list$ShOr$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", msy_btrigger = 11)
plot_hysteresis_ShOr

plot_hysteresis_Buchan <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_Buchan, brkpt_results_list$Buchan$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", msy_btrigger = 11)
plot_hysteresis_Buchan

plot_hysteresis_Banks <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_Banks, brkpt_results_list$Banks$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", msy_btrigger = 11)
plot_hysteresis_Banks

plot_hysteresis_Downs <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_Downs, brkpt_results_list$Downs$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", msy_btrigger = 11)
plot_hysteresis_Downs
```

### save plot

```{r} ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),        plot = plot_hysteresis_full,        bg = "white",        width = 10,        height = 10,        dpi = 300)}
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r} ### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R  source("R/model_comp_functions.R")  SSR_analysis <- run_srr_analysis(     data_for_srr = Herring_full[-(79:78),],    recruit_col = "R",    ssb_col = "SSB",    opt_brks_val = 4)  print(SSR_analysis$comparison_table)  #### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE  #### Strucchange breakpoint analysis bpts_SRR <- strucchange :: breakpoints(R ~ SSB, data = Herring_full) bpts_SRR_sum <- summary(bpts_SRR) opt_brks_SRR <- opt_bpts(bpts_SRR_sum$RSS["BIC",]) opt_brks_SRR #2 bpts2_SRR <- strucchange:: breakpoints(bpts_SRR, breaks = opt_brks[1]) bpts2_SRR <-strucchange :: breakpoints(bpts_SRR, breaks = opt_brks_SRR)  best_brk_SRR <- Herring_full$SSB[bpts2_SRR$breakpoints] best_brk_SRR #### 264793.8,  2391903.7 best_brk_years_SRR <- Herring_full$year[bpts2_SRR$breakpoints] best_brk_years_SRR #### 1981,      2002}
```

## Plotting

```{r} plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, best_brk_years_SRR, "Full Stock", "strucchange") plot_SRR_full}
```

#### save plot

```{r} ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),        plot = plot_SRR_full,        bg = "white",        width = 10,        height = 10,        dpi = 300)}
```

# tGAM

```{r} ### Merge env data to fishing tGAM_data <- merge(Herring_full, env_df_full,by = "year") %>%   select(year, SSB_lag, R, Mean_SST, Mean_SBT, Mean_SSS)  ### Run threshold gam function from "functions" with each variable run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SST", "year") # FALSE, 10.87623 run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SBT", "year") # FALSE, 8.561897 run_threshold_gam(tGAM_data, "R", "SSB_lag", "Mean_SSS", "year") # FALSE, 34.42214  #### No significant threshhold effect found}
```
